title: May our reader name this site in its User-Agent?
summary: Say whether our reader may name this site's address in its User-Agent: six outlets answer 403 to an unnamed robot, and Wikimedia asks robots for a name and a way to reach the operator. Three sites refuse our plain client name (lisboa.pt, expresso.pt, rede-expressos.pt): a browser-like name would be used only on your word.
closes: Your yes or no; on yes, the reader's requests carry the name.
blocks: SIC Notícias, JN, TSF, Renascença, The Guardian and AP are not read; Wikidata is not read.
